label: VAT registration threshold: 60 000 €, not 75 000 €
text: The finance ministry circulated a corrected VAT directive (ZDDS amendment published for consultation on minfin.bg) that lifts the mandatory-registration threshold from the current ~51 300 € to 60 000 € from 1 Jan 2027, walking back the 75 000 € figure in the original draft after IMF criticism — the number that keeps being quoted in the 26–27 Oct budget coverage.
